title: Enable automatic Time Machine backups
summary: Turn on automatic backups for your Mac using the command line. This ensures your files are regularly saved to your backup destination.

steps.explain: Run this command to enable automatic Time Machine backups. You need administrator privileges.

rollback.explain: To undo this change and disable automatic backups, run this command.

warnings: This changes system backup settings. Ensure you have a valid backup destination configured before enabling.
